decision.explanation: The provided documents contain two distinct reports regarding Manuel Estrada Pérez. Document 1 (D1S2) explicitly states he was awarded the 'Medal of Francysk Skaryna' by the Belarusian Embassy. Document 2 (D2S2) explicitly states he was bestowed with the title 'Knight of the Order of the White Rose of Finland' by the Finnish government. Both assertions are direct, supported by specific text segments, and refer to the same entity receiving different awards. The instruction to treat distinct valid namesakes and complementary answers as coexisting applies here, as receiving multiple awards is a single event type with multiple outcomes, not a contradiction requiring selection of one over the other. Both answers are present in the R5_answers and candidate lists.
